parameters.name: StoragePath
parameters.description: Path where the process fault logs must be stored.

parameters.name: LastUpgradeCount
parameters.description: Total number of process faults which occurred since last firmware upgrade.

parameters.name: PreviousBootCount
parameters.description: The number of process faults which occurred during the previous boot cycle.

parameters.name: MinFreeSpace
parameters.description: Minimum free space in {{units}} on the device that must be free before attempting to create a {{object|ProcessFault}} instance. This setting does not affect the counting of process faults.

parameters.name: RotateProcessFaultEntries
parameters.description: When enabled and once the maximum {{object|ProcessFault}} entries as indicated by {{param|MaxProcessFaultEntries}} are reached, the oldest entry, determined by {{param|ProcessFault.{i}.TimeStamp}}, is removed to make space for a new one, which is assigned a new instance identifier and a new {{param|ProcessFault.{i}.Alias}}. This setting does not affect the counting of Process faults.

parameters.name: MaxProcessFaultEntries
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries available in the {{object|ProcessFault}} table. Defines the maximum number of {{object|ProcessFault}} instances that can be stored on the device. When {{param|RotateProcessFaultEntries}} is {{false}} and this limit is hit, no new {{object|ProcessFault}} instances will be created until sufficient Process fault instances are removed. When {{param|RotateProcessFaultEntries}} is {{true}} and this limit is hit, the table {{object|ProcessFault}} is rotated as specified by {{param|RotateProcessFaultEntries}}. Set this parameter to 0 to completely disable the creation of {{object|ProcessFault}} instances. Reducing the {{param}} will cause for the implementation to delete the oldest {{object|ProcessFault}} instances. This setting does not affect the counting of process faults.

object.description: Monitoring process faults and configuring the operating system to generate crash dumps and core files is essential for diagnosing and troubleshooting issues with applications and processes.
